text:
maria: Pushed fixes for the retry backoff + integration test update — PTAL when you have a sec. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8422

jake: Quick skim — logic looks solid. Left one var-name nit (see comment). Not blocking. CI will tell us about flaky test.

sarah: Small docs note: can you expand the example for the new config flag? otherwise good.

maria: Addressed both comments, added changelog entry, and force-pushed. CI rerun queued.

ci-bot: Build started — runtime/unit-tests (sha: 3f7a9c2)

jake: Nice. Can you squash the WIP commit into the feature commit? Then i'm happy to approve once CI is green and canary is scheduled.

maria: Squashed and pushed. Also added a short note in the PR description about rollback behavior. Planning to merge during today's 16:00 PT merge window if no objections.

sarah: Left one inline about log level — non-blocking, but I'd prefer it set to DEBUG. I'll approve after that small change.

maria: Switched log to DEBUG and re-pushed. Canary scheduled per deploy ops.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled at 16:05 PT to canary-1 cluster

jake: :thumbsup: will watch canary health

sarah: Approving now — good catch on the retry edge case.

maria: Thanks all. Final PTAL welcome; i'll merge after the canary reports healthy. If anyone wants a heads-up before merge ping me.
